claims: No. 2 seed Vanderbilt defeated No. 7 seed Illinois 75-57 on March 23, 2026.
Vanderbilt advanced to their first Sweet 16 since 2009.
Mikayla Blakes led Vanderbilt with 25 points, 10 rebounds, and nine assists.
The game was at home for Vanderbilt in Nashville.
Berry Wallace scored 18 points for Illinois.
Vanderbilt remained undefeated at home in Memorial Gymnasium.
Justine Pissott scored 18 points for Vanderbilt.
Aubrey Galvan scored 12 points for Vanderbilt.
Berry Wallace is a sophomore for Illinois.
Berry Wallace had nine rebounds for Illinois.
Berry Wallace played through a mask due to a broken nose.
Vanderbilt’s defense held Illinois under 30% shooting (21 of 71).
Illinois shot 15-for-34 in the first half.
Vanderbilt moves on to face No. 6 seed Notre Dame in the Sweet 16.
